question: Raja Ram Mohan Roy's greatest achievement in the field of religious reform was the setting up of the _______ in 1828.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmo Samaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the **Brahmo Samaj** in 1828 in Kolkata.
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was established to reform and modernize Hindu society and to oppose superstitions and orthodox practices.
 
• It emphasized the worship of one God and rejected polytheism and idol worship.
 
• Roy's efforts through Brahmo Samaj significantly contributed to the social and religious renaissance in India.
 
• The movement played a crucial role in the abolition of practices like Sati and child marriage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prarthana Samaj**

 
 
• Prarthana Samaj was a reform movement founded by Dr. Atmaram Pandurang in 1867.
 
• It sought to make people believe in one God and discard caste restrictions, idol worship, and other social evils.
 
• This movement was influenced by the Brahmo Samaj.
 
 
 
• **Arya Samaj**
 
 
• Arya Samaj was founded by Swami Dayananda Saraswati in 1875.
 
• It aimed at reviving the Vedic way of life and opposed idol worship and caste-based discrimination.
 
• The Arya Samaj also emphasized education and social reforms.
 
 
 
• **Dev Samaj**
 
 
• Dev Samaj was founded by Shiv Narayan Agnihotri in 1887.
 
• It focused on moral and spiritual upliftment.
 
• The movement emphasized ethical living and social reforms.
